verdict.rationale: MailerLite is a SaaS email platform with AI features (an AI landing-page builder and a Claude integration), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training data policy, opt-out setting, or contractual commitment against training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
